title: 半曲长安 · ACE · 长风
reviewStatus: Source-informed review of large-v3 full-mix and vocal no-VAD ASR, normal vocal ASR, and independent MOSS lyrics. Human listening approval remains pending.
timingStatus: Full-mix no-VAD ASR word spans; source-close wording restored. The opening Chang'an name uses a grouped ASR span, not independently aligned syllables. Companion highlighting is approximate within each line.
notes: 28 performed lines, in planned order; final chorus line 25 is shortened to 等我回来. Do not append the unsung 坐在你身旁 there.
Both large-v3 passes collapse the first 长安 to 肠; MOSS and repeated hooks support 长安. Restore the name within the existing phrase anchor without fabricating separate character timing.
Preserve source-close 琴声, 城墙, 晚霞, 未尽, 渐淡, 认得, 丹霞, 远山, 半曲, 弹完 rather than recognizer homophones. Some consonants remain softened in this generated performance.
MOSS timestamps drift substantially late in the song and are not used as public timing.
Instrumental gaps and the fading ending are not lyric rows. No recording or social publication is authorized by this package alone.

lines.text: 半首琴声 留在长安
lines.en: Half a melody stays in Chang'an
lines.ja: 半分の調べを長安に残して

6.reason: The source lyric, independent MOSS transcription and later repeated hooks support Chang'an; both Whisper passes merge the name. Keep one approximate phrase span.

lines.text: 一半随我 越过千山
lines.en: The other half crosses a thousand mountains with me
lines.ja: もう半分は私と幾千の山を越える

lines.text: 城墙的风 拂过衣裳
lines.en: Wind from the city walls brushes my robes
lines.ja: 城壁からの風が衣をなでる

lines.text: 你把晚霞 别在我肩上
lines.en: You pin the sunset upon my shoulder
lines.ja: あなたは夕焼けを私の肩に留める

lines.text: 一曲未尽 天色已晚
lines.en: The tune is unfinished, but night has fallen
lines.ja: 一曲が終わらぬうちに夜が来た

lines.text: 我说等我 再续下一段
lines.en: Wait for me, I said; we will play the next part
lines.ja: 待っていて、続きをまた奏でようと言った

lines.text: 马蹄声远 灯火渐淡
lines.en: Hoofbeats recede, and the lamplight fades
lines.ja: 蹄の音は遠ざかり、灯は薄れてゆく

lines.text: 回头还有 你在城南
lines.en: I turn back; you are still there, south of the city
lines.ja: 振り返れば、城南にあなたがいる

lines.text: 半首琴声 留在长安
lines.en: Half a melody stays in Chang'an
lines.ja: 半分の調べを長安に残して

lines.text: 一半随我 越过千山
lines.en: The other half crosses a thousand mountains with me
lines.ja: もう半分は私と幾千の山を越える

lines.text: 黄河再宽 隔不断想念
lines.en: However wide the Yellow River, it cannot sever my longing
lines.ja: 黄河がどれほど広くても、この想いは断ち切れない

lines.text: 风沙再大 认得你的眼
lines.en: Even through the fiercest sandstorm, I would know your eyes
lines.ja: どんな砂嵐の中でも、あなたの瞳を見分けられる

lines.text: 等我归来 坐在你身旁
lines.en: Wait until I return and sit beside you
lines.ja: 帰ってあなたの隣に座るまで、待っていて

lines.text: 把那半首 为你弹响
lines.en: I will let that half-finished melody ring out for you
lines.ja: 残した半分の調べを、あなたに奏でる

lines.text: 兰州的夜 水映星光
lines.en: On a Lanzhou night, starlight shimmers on the water
lines.ja: 蘭州の夜、水面に星明かりが映る

lines.text: 丹霞如火 染红了远山
lines.en: The Danxia cliffs blaze, reddening the distant mountains
lines.ja: 丹霞は炎のように、遠い山並みを赤く染める

lines.text: 风吹红衣 翻过山湾
lines.en: The wind lifts my red robes as I round the mountain bend
lines.ja: 風に紅の衣をなびかせ、山の曲がり道を越える

lines.text: 身后的人 都要平安
lines.en: May everyone behind me stay safe
lines.ja: 背にした人たちが、みんな無事でありますように

lines.text: 山河再远 心还有方向
lines.en: However far the journey, my heart still knows the way
lines.ja: 山河がどれほど遠くても、心は向かう先を知っている

lines.text: 你在窗前 为我留着光
lines.en: At your window, you leave a light for me
lines.ja: あなたは窓辺で、私のために光を残している

lines.text: 半首琴声 留在长安
lines.en: Half a melody stays in Chang'an
lines.ja: 半分の調べを長安に残して

lines.text: 一半随我 越过千山
lines.en: The other half crosses a thousand mountains with me
lines.ja: もう半分は私と幾千の山を越える

lines.text: 黄河再宽 隔不断想念
lines.en: However wide the Yellow River, it cannot sever my longing
lines.ja: 黄河がどれほど広くても、この想いは断ち切れない

lines.text: 风沙再大 认得你的眼
lines.en: Even through the fiercest sandstorm, I would know your eyes
lines.ja: どんな砂嵐の中でも、あなたの瞳を見分けられる

lines.text: 等我回来
lines.en: Wait for me to come back
lines.ja: 私が帰るのを待っていて

lines.text: 把那半首 为你弹响
lines.en: I will let that half-finished melody ring out for you
lines.ja: 残した半分の調べを、あなたに奏でる

lines.text: 那年未尽的半曲
lines.en: The half-finished tune from that year
lines.ja: あの年、奏できれなかった半分の調べ

lines.text: 今夜 为你弹完
lines.en: Tonight, I will play it to the end for you
lines.ja: 今夜、あなたのために終わりまで奏でる
